in_hebrew.name: אל-הי-לב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Gottlieb is derived from the German words 'Gott' meaning 'God' and 'lieb' meaning 'love' or 'dear'. However, there is no direct translation of this name into Hebrew, as it is a German name. The Hebrew representation shown here is a phonetic approximation of the name, representing the meaning 'God is my strength' in Hebrew characters.

in_greek.name: Θεός-αγάπη
in_greek.long_meaning: Similar to the Hebrew representation, the Greek representation of the name Gottlieb is not a direct translation, but rather a representation of the name's meaning in Greek characters. The name Θεός-αγάπη (Theos-agape) translates to 'God of love' in Greek.

in_latin.name: Deus-amor
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin representation of the name Gottlieb is 'Deus-amor', which translates to 'God of love' in Latin. This is a direct translation of the name's meaning, as Latin has a word for 'love' (amor) that can be combined with 'God' (Deus) to form a meaningful representation of the name.
